title: Treatment for Benign Prostatic Obstruction: Transperineal Laser Ablation
official: Randomized Clinical Trial Comparing Transurethral Prostate Resection (TURP) and Echolaser Soractelite-Transperineal Laser Ablation (TPLA ) in Patients With Lower Urinary Tract Symptoms Due to Benign Prostatic Obstruction
summary: THIS STUDY IS A RANDOMIZED CLINICAL TRIAL COMPARING TRANSURETHRAL PROSTATE RESECTION (TURP) AND ECHOLASER SORACTELITE-TRANSPERINEAL LASER ABLATION (TPLA) IN PATIENTS WITH LOWER URINARY TRACT SYMPTOMS DUE TO BENIGN PROSTATIC OBSTRUCTION. THE PRIMARY GOAL IS TO SHOW THE NON-INFERIORITY OF TPLA VERSUS TURP BY IPSS-SCORE.
